_meta_note: API-format ComfyUI workflow, as measured and actually executed on POD-3 (see POD-3#document-benchmark, section 6). Node ids below are whatever this file happens to use today -- app/workflow.py never hardcodes them; it discovers the Chatterbox TTS node, the voice-reference loader, and the save node by class_type and by how they are wired together. Swap this file for a different Chatterbox-family workflow (e.g. once the Board approves a production node package) with no code change, as long as it keeps exactly one Chatterbox-family node and exactly one save node wired to its output. PATH_TO_WORKFLOW_JSON in config/app_config.json points here.
